allegations.claim: a payload with no attributable consumption stayed pending with no time limit: a paste that never lands, or lands rewritten, blocked every later clipboard insert, both Paste Again paths, every copy offer and undo recovery until the user copied something
allegations.observed_first_pass: dropped paste: job-2 in app B 1 s later saved_not_inserted/clipboard_payload_pending, job-3 offer withheld, job-4 in A 2 s later refused; newline-normalized paste (field grew): readback mismatch, three later jobs refused, user clipboard never restored
allegations.invariant: stable permitted insertion stays green (no 'safe because everything refuses'); attributable change means consumption; D8 'resolves when its destination shows the paste landed'
allegations.repair: ea83bc1: readback 'normalized' (field grew by exactly the pasted length, region rewritten) counts as consumption; a pending payload lapses PENDING_PAYLOAD_SEC (5 s) after its post and is restored away while still owned
allegations.residual: a consumer later than 5 s after an unseen paste on a readable surface pastes the restored user clipboard (contracts/insertion.md limitations)

allegations.claim: a readback read failing at the settle deadline returned None, treated as an unobservable surface: the user's clipboard was restored and a late consumer pasted it
allegations.observed_first_pass: posted_unverified/readback_unavailable, restored_types ['public.utf8-plain-text']; after the late consumer F1 = 'abc CANARY_OLD_CLIPBOARD'
allegations.invariant: AUDIT-07: the destination never receives the old clipboard as the dictation; readable surfaces keep ownership
allegations.repair: ea83bc1: only a destination with no pre-state restores on None; a readable destination whose readback failed keeps ownership (pending)

allegations.claim: the live selection read after validation was never checked against the lease: a selection made after validation was replaced (caret lease), and an extended strict selection was replaced (replacement lease)
allegations.observed_first_pass: 'keep this sentence' -> 'keep DICTATED sentence' reported confirmed; strict 'alpha beta gamma' -> 'OMEGA gamma', then undo reported undone with ' beta' lost
allegations.invariant: D4 (no authority over a selection made later), D5 / M11-AC03, D3
allegations.repair: ea83bc1: the effect boundary re-checks the authorized selection before the AX write, the publication and the post (target_changed/selection_changed_before_effect); a moved caret remains the insertion point
allegations.residual: a selection change between the check and the effect (microseconds; the documented non-atomic boundary)

allegations.claim: the undo record was armed for every outcome, including match_ambiguous; equal text at the owned range was then undo's only proof
allegations.observed_first_pass: no-op AX setter over 'Thanks, Sam': readback match_ambiguous; undo reported undone and left ' Sam'
allegations.invariant: AUDIT-08 (matching bytes grant no permission), D6
allegations.repair: ea83bc1: the undo record is armed only by an attributable 'match' readback

allegations.claim: after undoing a caret insert the check read a zero-length range and compared it to '' (always equal)
allegations.observed_first_pass: setter no-op on undo: outcome undone while F1 still 'abc red'; the undo record cleared, no recovery offered
allegations.repair: ea83bc1: 'undone' also requires the field length to move by the owned length less the restored length; otherwise undo_unverified

allegations.claim: the terminal category came from one frontmost read and the destination was bound by another; the effect boundary then re-checked against the terminal it bound
allegations.observed_first_pass: multi-line text pasted into the terminal field (posted_unverified/destination_not_recorded); the snapshot control refused (multiline_terminal_unverified)
allegations.invariant: D15 / F16: no execution path into an uncertified terminal
allegations.repair: ea83bc1: snapshot-less jobs classify the category of the application validation bound

allegations.claim: the duplicate flag was refreshed only when the field length changed; a same-length edit creating a duplicate went unseen and the observer re-anchored onto the user's copy
allegations.observed_first_pass: owned range moved (10,13) -> (3,6); the user's later 'cat' -> 'cap' recorded as owned_range_edited with after-text 'cap'; the real edit 'cat' -> 'cow' never recorded; the M14 miner examined the row and dismissed it
